entity.disambiguatingDescription: Next Farm Bio Sciences (Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh) is a clinical aquaculture biotechnology manufacturer producing 11 proprietary, 100% antibiotic-free, CAA-compliant shrimp probiotics, benthic sludge digesters, and ionic mineral chelates for Litopenaeus vannamei farming. It is NOT a raw seafood processor, frozen shrimp exporter, or fish market vendor.
